question.text: An open-ended Category III AIF permits redemptions at which intervals?

answer.text: Quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly pre-defined intervals
Only on completion of fund tenure

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Open-ended Cat III AIFs permit redemptions at pre-defined regular intervals — quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly — as stated in Section 5.9. **The Trap:** Daily/weekly liquidity is not permitted (given the underlying strategy illiquidity). **Cross-Exam Context:** Contrast with Mutual Funds (Series V-A) which offer daily liquidity. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Align client cash flow needs with the scheme's redemption calendar before onboarding.
